versions.changelog:
- Added a "Start on APIDot" section with direct entry points to Seedream 4 model, docs, dashboard, and examples.
- Clarified getting started flow for users coming from ClawHub.
- No functional changes; documentation only.
- Removed file: skill-card.md.

Initial release of the apidot-seedream-4-api documentation skill.

- Provides comprehensive documentation for building workflows using APIDot Seedream 4, including 4K image generation, editing, image-to-image, and reference image processes.
- Guides users on async task submission, status polling, webhook integration, and secure API key handling.
- Features detailed usage instructions, security guidelines, model routing references, and integration advice.
- Does not perform any network requests or include executable code; documentation-only.
- Directs users to official APIDot resources for copyable request examples and further details.
